requirements: Provide a publicly reachable deployed website with a working entry link on the user GitHub repository or profile.
Visitors can register their own accounts using an email address.
Send real verification codes to the supplied email and validate them during registration.
Each account has its own persistent profile, bookmarks, collections, saved searches, and history with user isolation.
current_gap: The delivered application runs locally. Public deployment and email verification code delivery were not implemented.
acceptance: A visitor on another computer can open the GitHub website link and use the deployed application.
A new visitor can receive an email verification code, complete registration, sign out, and sign back in.
Accounts retain their own research data across sessions and cannot access another user private records.
unresolved: Public website access is requested. Repository visibility remains private per the original requirement unless the user changes it; the GitHub entry location must accommodate external visitors.
status: Recorded for version 2.0 synthesis with the original requirements.
